title: Daily standup
description: App Store screenshot meeting: Kestrel Labs prepares the version two beta. Turns are scheduled back to back from measured Kokoro durations. The first 14 s are silent so the recording, started once the call is live, catches every line.

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: Quick one today. Yesterday I finished caching the schedule on the device. Today I'm on the sync after you reconnect.

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: One blocker: when the tablet's clock is wrong, sync can apply an older change on top of a newer one.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: I saw that too. I've logged it as a sync conflict bug, and it's my top test case.

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: Thanks. I'll switch to server timestamps, which should fix it.

turns.speaker: hannah
turns.text: The offline banner files are with Tomás. Today I'm on the release notes screen.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: Riverside Clinic is happy with read only offline for the beta. They'd like two clinics in the beta, and they need a data export for an audit. I'm sending the export steps on Friday.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Is the beta still on for the third of November?

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: Yes, as long as the timestamp fix lands this week.
